game_concept: A racing platformer set in Sand Dunes – Sandstone Arch, a natural sandstone arch: the caravan guide must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Integration Heist: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Sandstone Arch.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstone Arch: a natural sandstone arch
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandstone Arch, repeat each round: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Sandstone Arch. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the caravan guide ahead. Then check the heist value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the sandstone arch by solving code steps involving heist that move the caravan guide forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the sandstone arch first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Integration Heist
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Integration Heist' (Week 9 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Sandstone Arch'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how heist changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vultures in Sandstone Arch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
